_comment: Original move name (msg_0750) -> hood description for the move summary (msg_0749). Plain text; it is word-wrapped to 5 lines of 20 characters. Use the curly apostrophe.
Pound: Stomps the foe out with whatever’s handy. Basic but disrespectful.
Karate Chop: Strip mall dojo chop. Lands critical hits easy.
DoubleSlap: Backhands the foe two to five times. Pure disrespect.
Comet Punch: A two-piece and then some. Hits two to five times.
Mega Punch: Asks if the foe wants a fade. They get one.
Pay Day: Makes it rain on the foe. Picks up cash after the battle.
Fire Punch: Hands too hot to hold. May leave the foe burned.
Ice Punch: Cold cocks the foe with a frozen turkey. May freeze them.
ThunderPunch: A punch with a taser taped to the fist. May paralyze.
Scratch: Walks up and pistol whips the foe. Old school.
ViceGrip: A clothespin on the foe. Then a bigger one.
Guillotine: Lights out. If it lands, the foe is done. Rarely lands.
Swords Dance: Spins the gun on a finger like a movie. Sharply raises Attack.
Cut: Shanks the foe with a box cutter. Can clear small trees outside.
Gust: Fans the foe with a blast of wind. Hits flyers mid-air.
Wing Attack: Rolls up on the foe’s side and lets off a shot.
Whirlwind: Runs the foe off the block. Ends wild battles.
Fly: Catches a flight on turn one, dive-bombs the foe on turn two.
Bind: Zip ties the foe for two to five turns. They ain’t going nowhere.
Slam: Body bags the foe with a full-weight slam.
Vine Whip: Takes off the belt and whips the foe with it.
Stomp: A curb stomp. May make the foe flinch.
Double Kick: Two quick shots, pop pop. Hits twice.
Mega Kick: Kicks the door off its hinges onto the foe.
Jump Kick: Jumps out the bushes with a kick. Hurts the user if it misses.
Rolling Kick: Rolls up on skates with a spin kick. May make the foe flinch.
Headbutt: Checks the foe’s dome with a running headbutt. May make them flinch.
Sand-Attack: Pocket sand to the eyes. Lowers the foe’s accuracy.
Horn Attack: Leans on the air horn right in the foe’s ear.
Fury Attack: Spray and pray, two to five shots. Somebody’s getting hit.
Horn Drill: A drill, a bigger drill, an industrial drill. If it hits, the foe is done.
Tackle: Full metal jacket. A basic shot that always shows up.
Wrap: Duct tapes the foe for two to five turns.
Thrash: Crashes out for two to three turns, then gets confused.
Double-Edge: Goes kamikaze. Big damage but the user takes some recoil.
Tail Whip: Twerks on the foe. So disrespectful their Defense drops.
Poison Sting: A quick shiv dipped in something nasty. May poison.
Twineedle: Two buzzes of a tattoo gun. MOM. It gets infected: may poison.
Pin Missile: Fires a nail gun two to five times.
Leer: A cold stare down. Lowers the foe’s Defense.
Growl: Talks trash until the foe’s Attack drops.
Roar: Woop woop. The foe runs off. Ends wild battles.
Sing: Drops a track so smooth the foe falls asleep.
Supersonic: Bass boosted till the foe’s head rattles. May confuse.
SonicBoom: Pops the trunk on a wall of subs. Always does 20 damage.
Disable: Jams the foe’s gun. Their last move can’t be used for a while.
Acid: Throws battery acid. May lower the foe’s Sp. Def.
Ember: A hot shot. May leave the foe burned.
Flamethrower: Lobs a Molotov. Flames everywhere. May burn the foe.
Mist: Blows a vape cloud over the team. Stats can’t be lowered for 5 turns.
Water Gun: Cracks open a fire hydrant on the foe.
Hydro Pump: Opens a fire hose on the foe, full blast. Massive pressure.
Surf: A hydrant wave floods the whole block. Hits everybody. Rides across water outside.
Ice Beam: Ices the foe out in diamonds. May freeze them solid.
Blizzard: A shaved-ice machine buries the block. May freeze.
Psybeam: Puts the laser sight right on them. May confuse.
BubbleBeam: A stream of spit to the face. May lower the foe’s Speed.
Aurora Beam: The liquor store neon sign lights them up. May lower Attack.
Hyper Beam: Pistol jams, so out comes the minigun. Full auto. Has to reload next turn.
Peck: Pokes the foe hard in the chest.
Drill Peck: A jackhammer at 6 a.m., right on the foe.
Submission: Gets the foe to sign a 360 deal. The user takes recoil.
Low Kick: Sweeps the leg. Hits harder on heavier foes.
Counter: Claps back on a physical hit for double the damage.
Seismic Toss: Suplexes the foe. Damage equals the user’s level.
Strength: Pure muscle. Can push boulders outside battle.
Absorb: Taxes the foe. The user gets half of it back.
Mega Drain: Big tax. The receipt never ends. The user keeps half the damage as HP.
Leech Seed: The freeloading cousin moves in. Drains the foe’s HP every turn.
Growth: Bulks up. Raises Attack and Sp. Atk.
Razor Leaf: Flings razor-sharp zaza leaves. High critical-hit ratio.
SolarBeam: Bakes in the tanning bed one turn, fires the tan the next.
PoisonPowder: Pepper spray to the face. Poisons the foe.
Stun Spore: Clamps a parking boot on the foe. Paralyzes them.
Sleep Powder: Hands the foe a fat cigar. One drag and they’re out cold.
Petal Dance: Takes a victory lap for two to three turns, then gets confused.
String Shot: Silly string everywhere. Lowers the foe’s Speed.
Fire Spin: Doughnuts around the foe for two to five turns. They’re trapped.
Thunderbolt: The big taser. May paralyze the foe.
Thunder Wave: A stun taser. Paralyzes the foe.
Thunder: Drops a live power line on the foe. May paralyze.
Rock Throw: Tosses a brick at the foe’s head.
Earthquake: Drops the bass so hard the whole block shakes. Hits everybody.
Fissure: Opens a sinkhole under the foe. If it lands, they’re done.
Dig: Lays low underground, then pops up on turn two.
Confusion: Dangles the chain in front of the foe’s face. May confuse.
Psychic: Swings the chain like a hypnotist. May lower Sp. Def.
Hypnosis: Smooth talks the foe straight to sleep.
Meditate: Yoga class. Something cracks, but it works. Raises Attack.
Agility: Laces up the fresh pair. Sharply raises Speed.
Quick Attack: Rolls up in the whip, lets off, peels out. Always goes first.
Rage: Starts beef with a T-bone. Attack goes up every time the user gets hit.
Teleport: Dips out of a wild battle.
Night Shade: Clocks in for the night shift, mops the foe. Damage = the user’s level.
Mimic: Bites the foe’s whole style and copies its last move.
Screech: Sets off the car alarm. Sharply lowers the foe’s Defense.
Double Team: Calls the squad up. Raises evasion.
Recover: Reloads and patches up. Restores half its max HP.
Harden: Throws on the Kevlar. Raises Defense.
Minimize: Ducks into a clothing rack. Sharply raises evasion.
SmokeScreen: Hotboxes the whole spot. Lowers the foe’s accuracy.
Confuse Ray: Shines a flashlight in the foe’s eyes. Confuses them.
Withdraw: Hides out in the trap house. Raises Defense.
Barrier: Shoves the couch and the mattress in front. Sharply raises Defense.
Light Screen: A riot shield. Cuts special damage for 5 turns.
Reflect: The corner-store bulletproof glass. Cuts physical damage for 5 turns.
Focus Energy: Locks in. Critical hits come easier.
Bide: Keeps receipts for two turns. Then hits back double.
Metronome: Spins the wheel. Uses a random move. Could be anything.
Mirror Move: Runs the foe’s last move through the copier.
Selfdestruct: Goes out loud. Huge damage, but the user faints.
Explosion: Kaboom. Massive damage, but the user faints.
Egg Bomb: Eggs the foe’s house, then the foe.
Lick: Licks the foe’s ice cream. They’re too grossed out to move. May paralyze.
Smog: A hooptie backfires in the foe’s face. May poison.
Sludge: Throws gutter slop. May poison the foe.
Bone Club: Swings the bat for the fences. May make the foe flinch.
Fire Blast: A fire bomb. Big flames. May burn the foe.
Clamp: Presses the foe in a waffle iron for two to five turns.
Swift: Shots that ricochet till they hit. Never misses.
Spike Cannon: Staples the foe two to five times.
Constrict: A choke hold. May lower the foe’s Speed.
Amnesia: Didn’t see nothing. Sharply raises Sp. Def.
Softboiled: Grandma fixes a plate. Then the whole pot. Restores half its max HP.
Hi Jump Kick: Hops the fence with a knee. Hurts the user if it misses.
Glare: A death stare in the dark. Paralyzes the foe.
Dream Eater: Kills the dream of a sleeping foe and takes half as HP.
Leech Life: Mooches off the foe. Heals half the damage dealt.
Sky Attack: Calls in a pigeon air strike. Charges a turn. May make the foe flinch.
Bubble: Spits on the foe. May lower Speed.
Dizzy Punch: Ding-dong ditch, then rings the foe’s bell for real. May confuse.
Spore: A music box and a pacifier. Puts the foe to sleep.
Flash: A ring light right in the foe’s eyes. Lowers accuracy.
Haze: Waves a dish towel and sprays air freshener. Clears all stat changes.
Zen Headbutt: Rings the singing bowl, then a full-speed headbutt. May make the foe flinch.
Swagger: A drip check in the mirror. Confuses the foe, but sharply raises their Attack.
Rock Polish: A full car detail. Sharply raises Speed.
Ice Shard: Flicks ice cubes from the cup. Always goes first.
Revenge: Their name’s on the list. Double damage if the user got hit this turn.
Magnet Bomb: A giant magnet drags the foe in and the hubcaps pile on. Never misses.
Charge Beam: Charges the phone to 100% and fires. May raise Sp. Atk.
Night Slash: Lights out, then slash marks. High critical-hit ratio.
Helping Hand: The secret handshake. Powers up an ally’s move.
Captivate: A smooth pickup line. Sharply lowers Sp. Atk of the other gender.
Icy Wind: A window AC cranked to max. Lowers the foe’s Speed.
Earth Power: The manhole blows and launches the foe. May lower Sp. Def.
Tailwind: Tailgate party. Doubles the team’s Speed for a few turns.
Synthesis: Ring light, flashes, glow up. Restores HP.
Aeroblast: Fighter jets, then a giant sneaker from the sky. High crit ratio.
Extrasensory: A giant eye opens in the sky and reads their future. May make the foe flinch.
Gyro Ball: Flings a gold fidget spinner. Stronger the slower the user is.
Yawn: Reads them the terms and conditions. They fall asleep next turn.
Sweet Scent: Way too much cologne. Lowers evasion. Draws wild homies outside.
Body Slam: A belly flop off the diving board, right onto the foe. May paralyze.
Mud Bomb: A pigeon drops one right on the foe’s head. May lower accuracy.
Sunny Day: Beach chair, reflector, sun up for 5 turns. Fire moves hit harder.
Signal Beam: Finds full bars and blasts the foe with wifi. May confuse.
Air Cutter: A ceiling fan on HIGH flings its blades. High critical-hit ratio.
Mud Sport: Spa day in a mud bath. Weakens Electric moves.
Water Sport: Super Soaker and the sprinkler dance. Weakens Fire moves.
Mud Shot: A mud pie to the face. Lowers the foe’s Speed.
Wake-Up Slap: The alarm, then the chancla. Double damage on a sleeping foe.
Brine: Salt in the wound. Double damage if the foe is under half HP.
Toxic Spikes: Scatters rusty nails. Poisons foes that switch in.
Rock Blast: Pebbles at their window, two to five times. You up?
Discharge: Six cords, one outlet. Shocks everybody. May paralyze.
Astonish: You’ve been served. May make the foe flinch.
Aqua Tail: Snaps the foe with a wet durag.
Air Slash: A flurry of past due bills. May make the foe flinch.
Whirlpool: Flushes the foe down a swirl for two to five turns. Clears whirlpools outside.
Flail: Windmills both arms like a maniac. Hits harder the lower their HP.
Waterfall: A hydrant blasts the foe sky high. May flinch. Climbs waterfalls.
Crabhammer: It’s hammer time. High critical-hit ratio.
Fury Swipes: Pickpockets the foe two to five times.
Rest: Takes a nap. Full HP and status cured, asleep two turns.
Rock Slide: Builds a brick wall on the foe, then drops it. May make them flinch.
Hyper Fang: Gold wind-up chattering teeth chomp the foe. May make them flinch.
Sharpen: Knife on the sharpening steel. Raises Attack.
Tri Attack: A hat trick, three fitted caps. May burn, freeze or paralyze.
Super Fang: Slaps a clearance tag on the foe. Takes half its HP.
Slash: A switchblade slash. High critical-hit ratio.
Substitute: Puts a fall guy out front using a quarter of its HP.
Triple Kick: Tap shoes to the face, getting stronger every tap.
Spider Web: Lures the foe onto a glue trap. They can’t leave.
Mind Reader: Reads the foe’s palm. The next move can’t miss.
Flame Wheel: Does a burnout into the foe. May burn them.
Curse: Cusses everybody out. Works different for Ghost types.
Spite: Petty. Takes back everything it ever gave. Cuts the PP of the foe’s last move.
Powder Snow: Throws a snow cone. May freeze the foe.
Protect: Ducks and covers. Dodges everything for a turn.
Mach Punch: “Yo, free money!” Snuck him. Always goes first.
Scary Face: Flashes the gold grill. So bright it sharply lowers the foe’s Speed.
Faint Attack: A sneak diss that never misses.
Sweet Kiss: Blows the foe a kiss. Now they got questions. Confuses.
Belly Drum: Beats the box. Maxes Attack for half its HP.
Sludge Bomb: A stink bomb. May poison the foe.
Octazooka: Blows a Bazooka bubble till it pops in the foe’s face. May lower accuracy.
Spikes: Spills a box of thumbtacks. Hurts foes that switch in.
Detect: Peeps the game. Dodges everything for a turn.
Bone Rush: Swings the bat two to five times.
Lock-On: Binoculars up. The next move can’t miss.
Outrage: Rage quits for two to three turns, then gets confused.
Giga Drain: An IRS audit. The user keeps half the damage as HP.
Endure: Tough it out. Survives any hit with 1 HP.
Charm: Hits the foe with rizz. Sharply lowers its Attack.
Rollout: Rolls out for five turns, harder every hit.
False Swipe: Just grazes them. Always leaves at least 1 HP.
Spark: Flicks a lighter till it zaps, then charges in. May paralyze.
Fury Cutter: A stab combo that gets stronger every hit.
Mean Look: Blocks off the exit. The foe can’t leave.
Attract: A candlelit date for two. The foe may be too infatuated to attack.
Heal Bell: Last call. Lights on. Cures the whole crew’s status.
Return: Hits harder the more loyal the user is.
Present: A gift bomb. Might hurt, might heal. Who knows.
Frustration: Big mad. Hits harder the less the user likes you.
Safeguard: Hires security. No status problems for 5 turns.
Pain Split: Splits the bill. Both sides share their HP evenly.
Sacred Fire: Can I get an amen? Holy fire from the heavens. Often burns the foe.
Magnitude: A giant bass flops all over the block. Random strength. Hits everybody.
DynamicPunch: Lights an M-80 by the foe. Confuses them if it lands.
Megahorn: Rams the foe with a police bullhorn.
DragonBreath: Eats a raw onion and breathes on the foe. May paralyze.
Baton Pass: Passes it off to a teammate, stat changes and all.
Encore: Run it back. The foe repeats its last move a few turns.
Pursuit: Chases down a foe trying to switch out. Double damage.
Rapid Spin: Laps round the foe on a BMX. Clears traps like thumbtacks.
Metal Claw: Brass knucks. May raise the user’s Attack.
Vital Throw: Not on the list. Bounced out the club. Goes last but never misses.
Morning Sun: Snooze, snooze, then rise and grind. Restores HP depending on the weather.
Hidden Power: Pulls the hidden strap. Its type depends on the user.
Twister: A tornado. May make the foe flinch.
Rain Dance: Makes it rain for 5 turns. Water moves get stronger.
Crunch: A hollow point round. May lower the foe’s Defense.
Psych Up: The hype man gets them going, copying the foe’s stat changes.
ExtremeSpeed: The getaway, on a rental scooter. Goes first with a hard hit.
AncientPower: OG power. May raise all of the user’s stats.
Future Sight: Has a premonition. The hit lands two turns later.
Rock Smash: Smash and grab. May lower the foe’s Defense.
Beat Up: The whole crew pulls up, one at a time.
Uproar: Turns up for three turns. Nobody sleeps.
Will-O-Wisp: Flicks a Bic at the foe. Burns them.
Facade: Stunts in a rental. Hits harder when burned, poisoned or paralyzed.
Focus Punch: Squares up for a fair one. Fails if the user gets hit first.
SmellingSalt: A gym sock under the nose. Double damage if they’re paralyzed.
Taunt: Drops a diss track. The foe can only attack.
Secret Power: An inside job. Its side effect depends on the spot.
Aerial Ace: An ace shot that never misses.
Bulk Up: Hits the gym. Raises Attack and Defense.
Calm Mind: Cucumbers on the eyes. Raises Sp. Atk and Sp. Def.
Dragon Dance: Does the shmoney dance. Raises Attack and Speed.
Poison Jab: A dirty shiv. May poison the foe.
Close Combat: A throwdown. Lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def.
Stone Edge: Shades on, rocks up. High critical-hit ratio.

Fire Fang: A hot grill bite. May burn or flinch.
Ice Fang: Chugs a slushie, brain freeze, icy chomp. May freeze or flinch.

Sucker Punch: A cheap shot before the foe attacks. Goes first.
Vacuum Wave: High noon. Draws first. Always goes first.
Assurance: Insurance payout. Double damage if the foe’s already hurt.
Fling: Tosses the held item at the foe.
Bullet Seed: Spits sunflower seeds like a machine gun, two to five times.
Iron Head: A steel core round. May make the foe flinch.
Giga Impact: Plows into the foe in an 18-wheeler. The user has to recover next turn.
Blast Burn: Lighter fluid on the grill. Too much. The user rests next turn.
Hydro Cannon: Cracks the fire hydrant wide open. The user rests next turn.
Frenzy Plant: Plants bullets. Grows a garden of guns. The user rests next turn.
Bite: Chomps down with a full set of gold grillz. May make the foe flinch.
Brick Break: Karate chops through bricks. Breaks the foe’s Reflect and Light Screen.
Shadow Ball: Rolls a Magic 8-Ball at the foe. Outlook not good. May lower Sp. Def.
Foresight: Clocks the foe on sight. No hiding, no dodging, no ghosting.
Water Pulse: A water balloon to the dome. May leave the foe dazed and confused.
Toxic: A double cup of the dirty stuff, to the face. Badly poisons the foe.
Take Down: Charges in swinging a folding chair. Hurts the user too.
Aqua Ring: Kicks back on a pool float. Restores a little HP every turn.
Payback: Gets back at the foe: their stuff out on the lawn. Twice as hard if it moved first.

Dark Pulse: Pure dark vibes off a black candle. May make the foe flinch.
Nasty Plot: The conspiracy board. It’s all connected. Sharply raises Sp. Atk.

Last Resort: Out of options. Throws the kitchen sink. Only works after every other move.
Fake Out: Crossover, crossover, ankles gone. First turn only. Flinches.
X-Scissor: Salon shears. Snip, snip. Leaves a bald spot.
Lava Plume: The lava lamp erupts on everybody. May burn.

Bounce: Pogos off the top of the screen, lands on the foe’s head next turn. May paralyze.
Metal Sound: A fork on a chalkboard. Sharply lowers the foe’s Sp. Def.

Roost: Crashes on an air mattress. Heals half its HP.

Iron Tail: A wrecking ball. May lower the foe’s Defense.
Rock Tomb: A dump truck buries the foe in gravel. Lowers Speed.
Overheat: Burns the toast. Smoke alarm going off. Sharply lowers the user’s Sp. Atk.
Energy Ball: Shotguns an energy drink, fires the caffeine. May lower Sp. Def.

Skill Swap: Trades cards with the foe. Then trades spots. Swaps Abilities.

Pluck: Grabs the foe’s berry with a reacher. Eats it.

Bug Bite: Bed bugs. If the foe’s holding a Berry, the user eats it.

Meteor Mash: A slam dunk from orbit. May raise the user’s Attack.
Fake Tears: Crocodile tears. Sharply lowers the foe’s Sp. Def.

Gunk Shot: The garbage truck unloads on the foe. May poison.
Reversal: Down 0 to 99, then the buzzer beater. Stronger the lower its HP.

Aqua Jet: Jet ski to the face. Always goes first.
Shadow Sneak: Footsteps behind the foe. Always goes first.
Covet: “Lemme see that real quick.” Walks off with the foe’s item.
Wood Hammer: Measures twice, then just swings the two-by-four. Big recoil.
Slack Off: Kicks back in the recliner. Restores half its max HP.
Seed Flare: Pollen count: EXTREME. Sneezes so hard it hurts. May sharply lower Sp. Def.
Dark Void: The whole block’s lights go out. The foes fall asleep in the dark.
Aura Sphere: Farms aura pose by pose, then throws all of it. Never misses.
Dragon Rush: Rush hour stampede off the subway. May make the foe flinch.
Memento: Faints, but the RIP tee hits so hard the foe’s Attack and Sp. Atk drop way down.
Refresh: Scrubs the kicks clean. Heals burn, poison and paralysis.
Muddy Water: A car through the puddle at the bus stop. May lower accuracy.
Heal Block: “You’re cut off.” The foe can’t heal for five turns.
Punishment: Time out in the corner. Hits harder the more the foe’s stats went up.
Switcheroo: Shell game with two bags. Swaps held items with the foe.
Chatter: Yaps nonstop till the foe’s head spins. May confuse.
Acupressure: A coin in the mall massage chair. Sharply raises a random stat.
Needle Arm: Swab, needle, jab. May make the foe flinch.
Ominous Wind: Somebody let one go in the elevator. May raise all the user’s stats.
Me First: Skips the whole line and uses the foe’s move first, harder.
Copycat: Plays a burned CD of the last move used.
Gastro Acid: A gas station hot dog. The foe’s Ability is out of commission.
Force Palm: A stiff arm to the face. May paralyze.
Howl: AWOOO - the whole crowd howls back. Raises Attack.
Imprison: Locks up every move the foe shares with the user.
Follow Me: “LOOK AT ME.” Every foe has to target the user.
Ice Ball: Packs and throws snowballs for five turns, harder each hit.
Magnet Rise: Hops on a hoverboard and somehow it floats. Immune to Ground moves for five turns.
Tail Glow: Bonnet off, edges laid. A whole glow up. Drastically raises Sp. Atk.
Luster Purge: Flicks the brights on the foe. Blink, blink, FULL BEAMS. May lower Sp. Def.
Attack Order: Order placed. Every delivery driver in the city pulls up. High crit ratio.
Gravity: Everybody’s pants sag for five turns. Nobody’s flying anywhere.
Healing Wish: Makes a wish on a shooting star and is gone. The next one in gets fully healed.
Mirror Coat: Mirror tint on the windows. Special attacks bounce back double.
Psywave: Checks the vibe. The vibes are bad. Random damage.
Nature Power: The bodega cat handles it. Changes with the spot.
Assist: Tags in a random teammate’s move.
Magic Coat: Hops in a bouncy castle. Status moves bounce right back.
Grudge: The foe’s photo on the dartboard. If the user drops, that move’s PP drops too.
Tickle: A feather duster. The foe can’t stop laughing. Lowers Attack and Defense.
Cosmic Power: The galaxy durag goes on. Raises Defense and Sp. Def.
Icicle Spear: Chips off ice with an ice pick, 2-5 times.
Poison Tail: A subway rat whips the foe with its tail. May poison.
Metal Burst: Takes the hit, then pays it back with interest.
Psycho Shift: Hot potato. Passes its status problem to the foe.
Power Trick: Flips the script: swaps Attack and Defense.
Role Play: A cheap costume of the foe. Copies its Ability.
Defend Order: Mall cops on segways surround the user. Raises Defense and Sp. Def.
Heal Order: Honey in the tea. Heals half its max HP.
Camouflage: Hi-vis vest and a clipboard. Blends in anywhere. Changes type.
Miracle Eye: Night vision goggles. Ghosts can’t hide. Evasion ignored.
Worry Seed: 3 a.m. thoughts. The foe can’t sleep.
Aromatherapy: Hangs up air freshener trees. Heals the team’s status.
Heart Swap: Swaps mood rings with the foe: all stat changes trade places.
Razor Wind: Blow dryer on HIGH, then it blasts next turn. High crit ratio.
Weather Ball: Shakes a snow globe of the block till the weather inside goes wild, then throws it.
Mirror Shot: Spinner rims catch the sun right in the foe’s eyes. May lower accuracy.
Psycho Cut: Throws shade. Literally: a lampshade, spinning. High crit ratio.
Transform: Face swap filter. Turns into the foe.
Sketch: A caricature artist draws the foe’s last move. Keeps it forever.
Conversion: Paint roller, new color: a full rebrand. Changes type.
Conversion 2: Flips the tape to the B-side. Changes type to resist the last hit.
Swallow: Takes the L. Swallows it whole and heals off what it stockpiled.
Power Swap: Pre-workout for the foe’s chamomile: swaps Attack and Sp. Atk changes.
Guard Swap: Good umbrella for the foe’s busted one: swaps Def and Sp. Def changes.
Arm Thrust: Shoves the foe off with a push broom, 2-5 times.
Cross Poison: Tags the foe with a dirty spray-paint X. High crit ratio. May poison.
